lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice explaining a change of plan with clear negation placement in main clauses.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: A social plan must be adjusted because transport and timing do not work.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Explaining that a plan cannot happen as expected and suggesting a small change.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik planned to meet in the evening, but one person cannot arrive on time and they adjust the plan.

main_focus.name: inte in main clauses with modal verbs
main_focus.description: Use inte after the first verb in a main clause, including after modal verbs such as kan and måste.
model_examples: Jag kan inte komma klockan sex.
Bussen går inte förrän halv sju.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use main-clause negation naturally 3-4 times in the dialogue.

allowed_supporting_grammar: simple reason clauses with för att
avoid_grammar: subordinate-clause negation as the main teaching point

useful_chunks: Jag kan inte komma i tid.
vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use practical transport and timing language without making the dialogue a travel lesson.

dialogue_shape.opening: One person explains that the original plan will not work.
dialogue_shape.middle: They give a simple reason, ask a follow-up question, and compare two possible times.
dialogue_shape.ending: They agree on a later time or a simpler version of the plan.

target_complexity.repetition: repeat inte with different common verbs

focus: the reason the original time does not work

sentence_focus: one sentence with går inte about transport
one question suggesting a changed plan
one sentence combining a reason and a new time
